content.user_title: Create Gemini Images with Nano Banana
content.value_statement: Image generation often requires switching tools and assembling CLI options. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code concise commands for Gemini image creation, editing, and grounded image prompts.
actual_capabilities: Runs Gemini 3 Pro Image generation through the infsh CLI.
Runs Gemini 2.5 Flash Image for faster image creation and edits.
Supports text-to-image prompts, image URL inputs, and multi-image output counts.
Shows options for aspect ratio, resolution, output format, and search grounding.
Lists and searches Gemini image apps available through inference.sh.
limitations: Requires the inference.sh CLI and a working infsh login.
Sends prompts and image inputs to external model services.
Does not generate images locally inside Claude, Codex, or Claude Code.
Model availability, pricing, and rate limits depend on inference.sh.

use_cases.title: Rapid Concept Art
use_cases.description: Generate several visual directions for a campaign, scene, or product idea before detailed design work begins.

use_cases.title: Marketing Visual Drafts
use_cases.description: Create prompt-driven imagery for social posts, landing pages, and presentation drafts with repeatable CLI options.

use_cases.title: Developer Image Workflows
use_cases.description: Use scripted CLI examples to test image prompts, aspect ratios, and generated assets during application development.

prompt_templates.title: Beginner Image Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Create one image from a simple description.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nano-banana to create one photorealistic image of a calm workspace with plants, soft daylight, and a clean desk.

prompt_templates.title: Style Variation Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nano-banana to generate four logo concepts for a neighborhood bakery. Make each option simple, warm, and easy to read.

prompt_templates.title: Image Editing Request
prompt_templates.scenario: Modify an existing image using an input URL.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nano-banana to edit this product photo from the provided URL. Replace the background with a bright studio setting.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Grounded Scene
prompt_templates.scenario: Use model options for a more specific result.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nano-banana with Gemini 3 Pro Image, 16:9 aspect ratio, 4K resolution, and search grounding for a current Tokyo weather scene.

output_examples.input: Create a 16:9 product hero image for a smart desk lamp.
output_examples.output: A concise generation plan using Gemini 3 Pro Image, a refined product prompt, and a wide aspect ratio setting.

output_examples.input: Edit an existing landscape image to add a rainbow and brighter sky.
output_examples.output: A guided image editing request that uses the supplied image URL and a clear change description.

output_examples.input: Find Gemini image apps and choose a fast model for four logo drafts.
output_examples.output: A short recommendation to use Gemini 2.5 Flash Image with four outputs and a simple logo prompt.

best_practices: Review prompts before running infsh commands that send content to external services.
Use Gemini 3 Pro Image for quality-sensitive work and Gemini 2.5 Flash Image for fast drafts.
Specify aspect ratio, style, lighting, and output count before generating final images.
anti_patterns: Do not send confidential images or private prompts without approval.
Do not ask the agent to run npx installation commands without confirming the source.
Do not enable Google Search grounding when the image should avoid current web context.

faq.question: What does Nano Banana do?
faq.answer: It helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code run Gemini image generation and editing through the inference.sh CLI.

faq.question: Does it work without inference.sh?
faq.answer: No. The skill depends on the infsh CLI and an authenticated inference.sh account.

faq.question: Which image models are documented?
faq.answer: The skill documents Gemini 3 Pro Image and Gemini 2.5 Flash Image.

faq.question: Can it edit existing images?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports image editing when the request includes input image URLs accepted by the model.

faq.question: Can it create several images at once?
faq.answer: Yes. The documented options include a num_images setting for multiple outputs.

faq.question: What should users review before use?
faq.answer: Users should review external service terms, prompt privacy, image rights, and any cost or rate limit rules.
